notes.title: Development on our game is still ongoing
notes.notes: [p]We know it’s been a while since our last update, but rest assured—we haven’t abandoned the project. The game is very much alive and moving forward.[/p][p]Over the past months, we’ve been rebuilding the foundation of the game. In particular, we redesigned the NPC framework, which will allow us to add richer and more varied content in the future. We also reworked the weapon system so that player weapons can now support more features and mechanics.[/p][p]At the same time, we trimmed away some redundant designs to achieve a more focused and pure arcade-style experience. Our goal is to keep the gameplay fast, fun, and easy to dive into.[/p][p]We’ll be sharing more details in the coming updates so you can see the progress more clearly. Thank you all for your patience and continued support—it means a lot to us![/p][p][/p][p]Bon Team[/p]

notes.title: 🧪 Beta Channel Now Available!
notes.notes:
We've launched a new Beta testing channel for *Battle of Nowhere*. If you're interested in trying out new game mechanics and experiences, feel free to switch to the Beta channel.

[b]How to switch to the Beta channel:[/b]

1. Right-click on *Battle of Nowhere* in your Steam Library and select "Properties".
2. Navigate to the "Betas" tab on the left.
3. From the dropdown menu, select "beta - Beta Testing".
4. Close the window, and Steam will automatically update the game to the Beta version.

[b]🎯 FPS Optimization Tips for Quest Series Headset Users:[/b]

If you're using a Quest series headset and wish to unlock FPS limitations, please follow these steps:

1. Open: `C:\Program Files\Oculus\Support\oculus-diagnostics\OculusDebugTool.exe`
2. Set Asynchronous Spacewarp (ASW) to **Disabled**
3. Set Adaptive GPU Performance Scale to **Off**

These settings can help enhance the game's smoothness and responsiveness.

[b]🛠️ v0.11.0 Update Highlights[/b]

- Players no longer lose vision when losing HP.
- Reworked all combat mechanics for an improved experience.
- NPCs are now more aggressive, increasing the challenge.
- Increased the number of NPCs in each wave, making battles more intense.

Thank you for your support and feedback. Join our Discord community to discuss the game's future developments with us!

— BoN Dev Team
